peoplehood_note: A STATE (government of the Harkoni), not the Harkoni people themselves. The Harkoni are internally divided (loyalists vs isolationists) and are not reducible to their government.
identity_model_note: Polity = a state / political entity, an orthogonal dimension from species (people), culture, and region. A polity does not describe a whole people.
